# Public synthetic navigation renderer probe

These pages are independently generated by `python -m tools.public_navigation_fixture`
through normal production CSRF pairing against `NavigationJellyfin` MockTransport.
All upstream calls stay in process; no operator library, account or media is used.
The graph includes fifty unique episodes in 24/24/2 pages, an empty season and
a genuine production error response generated from synthetic upstream 403.
Every detail/poster is fetched; six boundary episodes negotiate PlaybackInfo within
the real resolver rate budget. Fifty successful playback negotiations are not claimed.

The exporter replaces private content URLs with harmless public request IDs,
private posters with the existing independently generated gradient and all playable
actions with the same public 30-second encoded clip. The media and poster are
pinned to the reviewed #9 asset revision. Diagnostics/disconnect become scope notices.
`probe.html` is our original public-API adapter, with a bounded request-ID report.
It loads the vendor's unmodified library from the vendor's HTTPS origin and returns
these pages through the documented interaction `handleRequest` callback.
No credential, private capability URL, storage, backend call or auth bypass is present.

This verifies rendering/navigation of application-derived pages only when actually
observed in official MSX. It cannot prove normal hosted private authentication,
dynamic permission transitions, private media delivery or physical TV behavior.
See `docs/series-navigation-results.md` for actual observations and limitations.
